Patch Set 2:

AI code review results below, please doublecheck

Problematic, see inline comments. This patch adds only the test: there is no LU-20296 fix in the tree or in a relation chain, and the test is not added to ALWAYS_EXCEPT. So on master the test either reproduces the stuck-CONNECTING bug (and hangs, see inline) or passes/fails for reasons unrelated to the fix. Should this be stacked on top of the actual fix?

commit.message:
LU-20296 tests: pick a new connection during ctx nego timeout

To verify that alternate connections will be tried if a timeout
occurs during security context negotiation, mainly after a
target failover.

Test-Parameters: testgroup=review-dne-selinux-ssk-part-2
